data.narrative:
KrattWorks is a Series A defense and security technology company founded by Mattias Luha and Tõnis Voitka, with reported revenue of €19.7M. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 same-sector peers at Series A and adjacent stages, comprising 2 public companies and 8 private firms. Top private comparables include Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI.

The peer-median method was applied across the 10-company cohort, yielding a median valuation of $1.0B against a range of $125M to $3.0B. Sample peers include Dream Security ($3.0B Series B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B Series B), Code Metal ($1.2B Series B), and both Castelion and Defense Unicorns at $1.0B Series B. The median reflects the concentrated valuations observed in frontier-stage defense technology, where capital availability and strategic importance support premium multiples.

The triangulated valuation range stands at $850M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median point of $1.0B. This analysis is based on a single applicable method and reflects peer-median positioning. Key uncertainties include the breadth of monetization beyond the reported €19.7M revenue base, execution risk at Series A stage, and customer concentration within the defense sector. Additional methods incorporating revenue multiples or DCF analysis would strengthen conviction in this range.
